text:
sam: FYI customer Nexelia says they will not accept our invoice without their internal requisition ID (they call it PR-Ref). Procurement blocked billing. Can we reissue quickly?
maria: Got it. Do we have the exact PR string from the customer? sometimes they need it in the invoice header not just the line notes.
sam: They sent: PR-2026-4578 and cost center CC-9982. Also asked for vendor code 55-4421 to match their SAP.
maria: Ok adding those is straightforward but need to confirm whether we should void the previous invoice or issue a corrected one. What is the invoice id?
sam: Original invoice INV-2026-7789. Customer explicitly wrote: "no invoice will be processed without PR-2026-4578 in the header and cost center on the invoice PDF."
procurement-elena: @maria we require the PO/PR in the invoice header for Nexelia otherwise their ERP rejects it during AP upload. Please include PR in the Invoice Number/Reference field and put cost center on each line.
maria: Understood. I'll prepare a corrected invoice with: ```Invoice: INV-2026-7789-CORR
Customer PR: PR-2026-4578
Cost center: CC-9982
Vendor code: 55-4421```
kevin: Quick Q — does reissuing affect revenue recognition or do we need finance sign-off? don't want to delay month close.
maria: Finance alerted. As long as we mark as corrected and reference original INV-2026-7789, they can treat as replacement not a new sale. I'll cc finance.
billing-bot: Invoice reissue queued: INV-2026-7789-CORR (batch id b-5643). ETA PDF/email 15m.
maria: Sent corrected invoice to accounts-payable@nexelia.com and uploaded their PR into invoice header field. Sent copy to kevin and sam.
sam: Confirmed receipt from Nexelia AP: "PR in header present, will process." :thumbsup:
procurement-elena: Great — once they confirm payment flow we'll close. Also note for future: add a small checklist for enterprise customers that require PR/PO for billing.
maria: Will add to the account billing notes and to the onboarding checklist. Closing ticket when payment confirmed.
kevin: Thanks everyone, appreciate the quick turn.
